description: Two-storey side-to-rear extension; single-storey rear extension; alterations and extension to the roof including a rear dormer; two roof lights in the front roof slopes; external alterations including repositioning of front entrance door
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed first floor rear extension &nbsp;would by reason of conflicting roof forms that
would intersect the proposed rear dormer. would result in an unduly obtrusive
and incongruous addition to the original dwellinghouse, failing to respect the
character and proportions of the dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the
locality. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high-quality design
aspiration of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D1, D3,
D4 of The London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow’s Local Plan (2021-2041)
and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document
Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12pt">The proposed first floor side extension by reason of excessive width would result in a disproportionate addition to the host dwelling. &nbsp;&nbsp;Furthermore, the addition of an additional front gable of a siginificantly larger scale to the original would subsume the character of the host dwelling resulting in an unduly obtrusive and incongruous addition to the original dwellinghouse, failing to respect the character and proportions of the dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the locality. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high-quality design aspiration of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies D1, D3, D4 of The London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow’s Local Plan (2021-2041) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span></p>
